lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabadai saad na aaio naam na lago piaar ||
lines.translation: One who does not savor the taste of the Shabad, who does not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord,

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa phikaa bolanaa nit nit hoi khuaar ||
lines.translation: and who speaks insipid words with his tongue, is ruined, again and again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਪਇਐ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kirat paiai kamaavanaa koi na metanahaar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, he acts according to the karma of his past actions, which no one can erase. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan dhan sat purakh satiguroo hamaaraa jit miliai ham kau saa(n)t aaee ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed is the True Being, my True Guru; meeting Him, I have found peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan dhan sat purakh satiguroo hamaaraa jit miliai ham har bhagat paaee ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed is the True Being, my True Guru; meeting Him, I have attained the Lord's devotional worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan dhan har bhagat satiguroo hamaaraa jis kee sevaa te ham har naam liv laaee ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed is the Lord's devotee, my True Guru; serving Him, I have come to enshrine love for the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਵੈਰੀ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਭ ਸਮ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan dhan har giaanee satiguroo hamaaraa jin vairee mitr ham kau sabh sam drisat dikhaaee ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed is the Knower of the Lord, my True Guru; He has taught me to look upon friend and foe alike.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਣਾਈ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: dhan dhan satiguroo mitr hamaaraa jin har naam siu hamaaree preet banaaee ||19||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, my best friend; He has led me to embrace love for the Name of the Lord. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮੁੰਧਿ ਵਿਦੇਸਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਿਤ ਝੂਰੇ ਸੰਮ੍ਹਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar hee mu(n)dh vides pir nit jhoore sa(n)mhaale ||
lines.translation: The soul-bride is at home, while the Husband Lord is away; she cherishes His memory, and mourns His absence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਦਿਆ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਨੀਅਤਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: miladiaa dhil na hovaee je neeat raas kare ||1||
lines.translation: She shall meet Him without delay, if she rids herself of duality. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਲੀ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਬਾਝੁ ਪਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak gaalee kooReeaa baajh pareet karei ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, false is the speech of one who acts without loving the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਚਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਲੇਵੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tichar jaanai bhalaa kar jichar levai dei ||2||
lines.translation: He judges things to be good, only as long as the Lord gives and he receives. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਜੀਅ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin upaae jee tin har raakhiaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord, who created the creatures, also protects them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit sachaa naau bhojan chaakhiaa ||
lines.translation: I have tasted the food of Ambrosial Nectar, the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਇ ਮਿਟੀ ਭਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tipat rahe aaghaai mitee bhabhaakhiaa ||
lines.translation: I am satisfied and satiated, and my hunger is appeased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਲਾਖਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh a(n)dar ik varatai kinai viralai laakhiaa ||
lines.translation: The One Lord is pervading in all, but rare are those who realize this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪਾਖਿਆ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak bhae nihaal prabh kee paakhiaa ||20||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is enraptured, in the Protection of God. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਜੇਤਾ ਜਗਤੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur no sabh ko vekhadaa jetaa jagat sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: All the living beings of the world behold the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਿਠੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dithai mukat na hovaee jichar sabad na kare veechaar ||
lines.translation: One is not liberated by merely seeing Him, unless one contemplates the Word of His Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai mail na chukaee naam na lagai piaar ||
lines.translation: The filth of ego is not removed, and he does not enshrine love for the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik aape bakhas milaaian dubidhaa taj vikaar ||
lines.translation: The Lord forgives some, and unites them with Himself; they forsake their duality and sinful ways.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ik darasan dekh mar mile satigur het piaar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, some behold the Blessed Vision of the True Guru's Darshan, with love and affection; conquering their ego, they meet with the Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satiguroo na sevio moorakh a(n)dh gavaar ||
lines.translation: The foolish, blind clown does not serve the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਲਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai bahut dukh laagaa jalataa kare pukaar ||
lines.translation: In love with duality, he endures terrible suffering, and burning, he cries out in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਸੇ ਨ ਉਪਕਰੇ ਅੰਤੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kaaran guroo visaariaa se na upakare a(n)tee vaar ||
lines.translation: He forgets the Guru, for the sake of mere objects, but they will not come to his rescue in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramatee sukh paaiaa bakhase bakhasanahaar ||2||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Instructions, Nanak has found peace; the Forgiving Lord has forgiven him. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਅਵਰੋ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: too aape aap aap sabh karataa koee doojaa hoi s avaro kaheeai ||
lines.translation: You Yourself, all by Yourself, are the Creator of all. If there were any other, then I would speak of another.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੋਲੈ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: har aape bolai aap bulaavai har aape jal thal rav raheeai ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself speaks, and causes us to speak; He Himself is pervading the water and the land.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਛੋਡੈ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣੀ ਪੜਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: har aape maarai har aape chhodai man har saranee paR raheeai ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself destroys, and the Lord Himself saves. O mind, seek and remain in the Lord's Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਈ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਮਨ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਚਿੰਦ ਨਿਸਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bin koee maar jeevaal na sakai man hoi nichi(n)d nisal hoi raheeai ||
lines.translation: Other than the Lord, no one can kill or rejuvenate. O mind, do not be anxious - remain fearless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਠਦਿਆ ਬਹਦਿਆ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੨੧॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
lines.transliteration: uthadiaa bahadiaa sutiaa sadaa sadaa har naam dhiaaeeai jan naanak guramukh har laheeai ||21||1|| sudh
lines.translation: While standing, sitting, and sleeping, forever and ever, meditate on the Lord's Name; O servant Nanak, as Gurmukh, you shall attain the Lord. ||21||1||Sudh||
